# NDN IPFS Chain — Enterprise IPFS for the AI Era
> Persistent, encrypted, trustless content addressing with multi-region pinning, HuggingFace model mirroring, Filecoin-backed deals, and smart-contract triggers.

## Key pages
- Landing: https://ndnanalytics.com/
- Whitepaper: https://ndnanalytics.com/whitepaper
- API Docs: https://ndn-api-1037328355027.us-west1.run.app/docs
- Status: https://status.ndnipfs.link
- Source code: https://github.com/dnkefua/ndn-ipfs-chain (Apache 2.0)

## About
NDN IPFS Chain is an enterprise IPFS pinning platform by NDN Analytics. It provides multi-region pinning across 9 regions / 3 clouds, HuggingFace model mirroring to IPFS, crypto-shredding with on-chain key deletion, smart-contract event triggers (Ethereum, Polygon, Arbitrum, Base, Optimism, Solana), Filecoin deal automation, and lifecycle policies (hot/warm/cold/glacier). The platform implements the NDN Data Protocol (NDP) v1.0 with three data planes: Blobs, Models, and Structured Records.
